selected_hypothesis: A fixed bivariate exponential Hawkes model of positive and negative structured-news arrivals, fit on 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-20 without price outcomes and rolled forward from 2026-07-21, produces a signed conditional-intensity imbalance that identifies SIC4/theme peer group-dates with positive net H10 SPY-excess after a 45bp round-trip cost; scale long-only notional continuously by that imbalance.
economic_mechanism: The Hawkes state measures endogenous clustering and sign transition in public information, while the peer-exposure map identifies the second-order transmission channel. The test asks whether a conditional arrival-state posterior adds information beyond static event polarity and beyond holding the same cohort equally.
falsifier: The candidate fails unless the event-arrival likelihood improves out of sample and the frozen trading read has positive mean and median decision contribution, positive chronological halves, higher net return per deployed dollar than both equal-notional controls, at least four of seven groups positive, and no group or decision above 40% of positive PnL.
